label: Capture Format
description: The capture system's rendering signature — negative area, tonality and the discipline each format imposes.

items.name: 35mm-full-frame
items.text: full-frame 35mm capture, the versatile reportage standard, honest grain and quick handheld framing

items.name: medium-format-67
items.text: 6x7 medium format capture, a negative five times the area of 35mm, cavernous tonal depth, gentle depth-of-field falloff and slow deliberate framing

items.name: large-format-4x5
items.text: 4x5 large format capture, immense resolving detail, shallow focus even at portrait apertures and the formal stillness of tripod-bound composition

items.name: digital-mf-back
items.text: digital medium-format back, clinical 16-bit color that refuses to clip, micro-contrast so fine that fabric weave and skin texture separate without any sharpening

items.name: instant-pack-film
items.text: peel-apart instant pack film, creamy tonality with chemistry roller streaks and ragged developer edges framing the image, every frame a one-off object

items.name: half-frame
items.text: half-frame 35mm capture, grain doubled by the small negative and a loose diaristic snapshot energy, framed vertically as if torn from a contact sheet

items.name: 8x10-contact
items.text: 8x10 contact-print rendering, continuous tone with no enlargement step and no visible grain at all, the deepest tonal scale photography offers

items.name: cinema-super35
items.text: Super 35 motion-picture capture, cinema color science with a gentle highlight shoulder, faint gate weave and frame-line jitter lending the still a lifted-from-footage feel

items.name: 617-panoramic
items.text: 6x17 panoramic capture, one sweeping three-to-one frame reading like a scroll, the eye forced to travel across layered scenery

items.name: 16mm-cine
items.text: 16mm cine capture, coarse dancing grain, softened resolution and documentary immediacy, blacks slightly lifted and alive

items.name: wet-plate-collodion
items.text: wet-plate collodion capture, blue-sensitive rendering that darkens skies and warms skin toward shadow, silvery chemical pours and artifacts at the edges, shallow swirling antique focus

items.name: pinhole
items.text: lensless pinhole capture, infinite depth of field with everything equally and softly unsharp, exposures running to seconds so anything moving thins to a ghost, corners falling into deep natural vignette

items.name: smartphone-vernacular
items.text: modern smartphone computational capture, everything in focus, multi-frame HDR holding sky and shadow in the same slightly flattened exposure, edges a touch over-sharpened — the candid vernacular of the camera that is always in a pocket
